purpose: Evaluate representation-specific causal multi-scale detectors and calibrated existing BOCPD on the frozen first-release ALFRED cohort; retain Post-Quiet Huber + MAD as the historical comparison baseline.

source.source_policy: Reuse exact source artifact and validate its manifest, normalized first-release tape, every raw ALFRED batch hash and contract; no new acquisition or source mutation.

representations.PAYEMS: causal first difference of first-release levels, as already declared by the frozen evaluation contract

analysis.historical_matching: Use the existing one-to-one maximum-cardinality/minimum-absolute-calendar-lag contract matcher with a symmetric +/-12-calendar-month window. Report post_break_recall only where detection_lag_days >= 0; report early_warning_matches separately where detection_lag_days < 0.
required_historical_diagnostics: episode_id coverage across the eight registered clusters
analysis.available_at_policy: Every hit maps to the row's first-release available_at. All scores, scales, confirmation and re-arm decisions use only values available at or before the hit row.

UNRATE.scale: MAD_40 of first differences, using only differences ending strictly before the current window
UNRATE.rearm: re-arm each direction after two consecutive scores for that direction fall below 0.5 times its frozen threshold

ICSA.scale: MAD_40 of first differences, using only differences ending strictly before the current window
ICSA.rearm: re-arm each direction after two consecutive scores for that direction fall below 0.5 times its frozen threshold

PAYEMS.scale: MAD_40 of delta_x values; do not apply np.diff to delta_x

Causal MultiScale (representation-specif.method: Use the series-specific level-excursion or first-difference-flow equations above. Score both directions across all registered windows and use the maximum directional score. Require two consecutive same-direction threshold crossings. Calibrate the maximum confirmed null score over either direction and every window.

Calibrated BOCPD.method: Call the existing p2_b_benchmark.p2c_engine.bocpd_detector without modifying its implementation. Set persistence=3 and calibrate only short_mass_threshold on the preregistered grid; all other BOCPD parameters and internal gates remain the existing defaults.
Calibrated BOCPD.holdout_policy: Open Holdout only for the single short_mass_threshold selected by the Development gate.

Post-Quiet Huber + MAD.method: Existing p2_b_benchmark.p2c_engine.post_quiet_huber_detector with scale_mode=mad; implementation unchanged. Reference baseline only.

null_protocol.seed_identity: SHA256(seed_namespace, normalized_tape_sha256, series_id, selected_AR_order, phase, replicate_index), first 64 bits as integer
null_protocol.null_generator: Existing stable AR(p) residual bootstrap; p=1..3 selected by minimum AIC using only the first 40 analysis observations; same generated null trace shared by every arm for a series/replicate.
null_protocol.phase_separation: Development and Holdout use disjoint phase identities and a new namespace. Holdout is generated independently and never used for threshold selection.
null_protocol.holdout_opening_rule: Select the lowest registered threshold/short_mass_threshold meeting the Development Wilson U95 gate first. Then score Holdout only at that single frozen setting. Do not score alternative thresholds on Holdout.

risk_gates.threshold_selection: For each applicable arm and series, select the lowest preregistered threshold meeting Development U95 <= 0.085. Evaluate that frozen setting once on independent Holdout.
risk_gates.promotion_policy: No automatic production promotion. Risk validation and historical post-break recall are separate results.

historical_comparison.unmatched_alarm_exposure: sum of per-series available_at exposure years across UNRATE, ICSA and PAYEMS
historical_comparison.episode_coverage: Report matched episode_id set, count, and denominator of eight; distinguish post-break episode coverage from any matched coverage.
